map.FPY = 一次合格数 ÷ 总生产数 × 100%。一次合格指无需任何返工/返修: FPY = first-time-good units ÷ total produced units × 100%. First-time-good means units that pass without any rework/repair; if a unit passes after repair, it is not counted as 'first-time-good'.
map.某工序当日投产 1000 件，其中 950 件一次合格、50 件经返修后合格：F: A process started 1000 units that day, of which 950 passed first time and 50 passed after rework: FPY = 950 ÷ 1000 × 100% = 95.00%. Although the final yield is 100%, FPY is only 95%, indicating 5% rework waste; the root cause of those 50 units should be traced rather than only looking at final shipment.
map.FPY 和最终合格率有何不同？: What is the difference between FPY and final yield?
map.最终合格率包含返修后合格品，掩盖了返工成本；FPY 只承认首次合格的单元，能更真: Final yield includes units passing after rework, masking rework cost; FPY only counts first-time-good units, more truthfully exposing process variation and waste, and is the metric Six Sigma values more.
map.FPY 低但合格率 100% 要不要管？: Should FPY be low but yield 100% be addressed?
map.要管。FPY 低意味着持续返工，带来人力、工时、设备占用与潜在质量风险；长期看会: Yes. Low FPY means persistent rework, bringing labor, hours, equipment occupation and potential quality risk; in the long run it erodes delivery and cost, and should be an improvement focus rather than ignored because of 'final pass'.
